_note: GAME-BLUFF §5.4: slurs and strong sexual or hateful terms only (mild swearing is allowed). `words`: whole tokens plus simple inflections (s/es/ed/er/ing…), after confusable, leet (n1gger) and letter-spacing (n i g g e r) folds. `glued`: also matched inside the despaced whole string (only entries that never occur inside an ordinary word). `allow`: phrases removed before matching.
